name: YDK-Gen (YANG Development Kit Generator)
what_it_is: A code-generation tool that consumes YANG model bundle profiles and produces strongly-typed Python, Go, and C++ SDKs with built-in service providers for NETCONF, RESTCONF, OpenDaylight, and gNMI. It combines pyang for model analysis, libyang for runtime validation, and pybind11 for C++-to-Python bindings.
components: generate.py — main code-generation script (core, bundle, adhoc, docs, tests)
install_ydk.sh — platform-aware installation script for all languages
ydkgen/ — Python package extending generate.py with YANG analysis logic
sdk/ — core stubs and samples for Python, Go, and C++
profiles/ — bundle and service JSON profiles (e.g., ietf_0_1_5.json, gnmi-0.4.0.json)
yang/ — YANG models used for unit testing
test/ — dependency scripts and unit test runners (run_py_tests.sh, run_go_tests.sh, run_cpp_tests.sh)
gen-api/ — output directory for generated SDK code (python/, go/, cpp/)
protocols: gNMI (via optional gnmi-0.4.0 service package, requires gRPC 1.9.1 and protobuf 3.5.0)
measurement: Unit test pass/fail results per language (Python, Go, C++) via test runner scripts
Code coverage tracked via codecov (badge in README)
Code quality grade via Codacy badge
configuration: YDKGEN_HOME — root of ydk-gen repository (defaults to $HOME/ydk-gen)
PYTHON_VENV — Python virtual environment location (defaults to $HOME/venv)
C_INCLUDE_PATH / CPLUS_INCLUDE_PATH — C/C++ header locations (defaults to /usr/local/include)
LD_LIBRARY_PATH — required on CentOS/RHEL for gRPC runtime (/usr/local/lib:/usr/local/lib64)
Bundle profile JSON — specifies name, version, core_version, and YANG model sources (dir/file/git)
fault_injection: No dedicated fault-injection framework; tests run against Cisco ConfD (NETCONF server) started via init_confd_ydktest, a moco-based REST server (start_rest_server.sh), and a TCP proxy server (tcp_proxy_server.py / start_tcp_server.sh)
pyang --verbose flag reveals YANG model syntax errors and missing dependency issues during bundle generation
modes: Bundle generation from profile: python3 generate.py --bundle <profile.json> {--python|--cpp|--go} -i
Service package generation: python3 generate.py --service profiles/services/gnmi-0.4.0.json
constraints: Python 2 is not supported; Python 3.5+ with shared library (e.g., libpython3.6m.so) required
gNMI service is optional and requires separate installation of gRPC 1.9.1 and protobuf 3.5.0
ConfD (Cisco licensed) is required to run the full NETCONF unit test suite; not included in the repo
Generated bundles from YDK-0.8.6 are not backward compatible with bundles generated by YDK-0.7.2 or earlier
sudo/root access required to install C/C++ core components to /usr/local/bin, /usr/local/lib, /usr/local/include
Supported OS: Ubuntu 16.04–24.04, CentOS 7, CentOS Stream 8, RHEL 7.x–8.x, macOS up to 11.6.2 (Big Sur)
docker_services: ydksolutions/ydk-gen:0.8.6.6 — single container image built on ubuntu:jammy; installs all dependencies, builds C++/Python/Go core and gNMI service packages, installs ydk-models-openconfig
notable_absences: No docker-compose.yml — the project ships a single Dockerfile, not a multi-service compose setup
No built-in network simulation or emulated device; NETCONF tests require an external ConfD license
No pre-built YANG bundles in the repo; bundles must be generated by the user from profile JSON files
No Windows native support; Windows users must use WSL with Ubuntu 18.04 or 20.04
